layers.text: Style (retro hacker chic skin): an old green-screen computer terminal at night. Only near-black and phosphor green (bright #33ff66, plus one dim and one dark green step), no other hues. Crisp pixel art made of thin 1-2 pixel glowing green lines and sparse dots on near-black, a faint glow around lines, calm and uncluttered. Backdrop: one wide empty scene seen straight from the side like a flat 2D game background, nobody in it, mostly dark and low in contrast so bright, colourful hand-drawn characters placed on top later stand out.

Subject: a night-time city horizon behind a game's victory screen. The top third is a black night sky with a few tiny green star pixels and a thin green crescent moon on the upper right. Just above the middle, a long low city skyline runs along the whole horizon: flat rectangular buildings and towers of different heights, dark silhouettes with thin glowing green outlines and a few dim green window dots, one or two antenna masts. From the horizon down to the bottom edge, one wide flat empty ground plane: a dark floor covered by a dim glowing green perspective grid of thin lines receding to the horizon, with nothing standing on it.
